title: One, Two, Three
label: ch:ge-zahlen-1-3
canDo: I can count one, two, three in German and say why each is the English number's twin rather than a Latin borrowing.

payoff.summary: The first three numbers, one per lesson, and then the sound law that explains every difference between them and their English twins. German's numbers were never borrowed from Latin; this chapter is where that stops being a claim and becomes something the reader can hear.
